Name: Weapons on Display
Author: GrendG
Description:
[b]Weapons on Display[/b] is pretty self-explanatory--it lets you display weapons on tables like many other items.  I had always hoped this feature would be added to the game, but it seems like it's a low-priority, so I decided to add it myself.  Love collecting weapons but think using signs is lame?  Me too!  With this mod you can finally set up a proper weapon collection and display it proudly.
  
[url=https://discord.gg/S5NQjbXPnb][img width=200,height=68]https://i.imgur.com/yX0xrk0.png[/img][/url]
[b]Problems, feature request, something else?  Join us on Discord![/b]
